title: Watering Tips
description: Water indoor plants 2–3 times a week. Always check the soil before watering to avoid overwatering.

title: Sunlight Tips
description: Place plants near windows with indirect sunlight. Avoid harsh direct sunlight for indoor plants.

title: Fertilizing Tips
description: Use organic fertilizer once a month to keep plants healthy and promote steady growth.

title: Humidity Care
description: Indoor plants love humidity. Light misting helps keep leaves fresh and green.
